Eggster is an Xposed Module that allows you to change your default Easter Egg present in Settings>About Phone to any of the present Official Easter Eggs.

How to use:
 1. Enable system framework, android easter egg and android system in Xposed/lsposed(vector)
 2. Reboot your device
 3. Open the app and choose any Easter Egg
 4. enjoy :)


Rewritten with love from scratch. Use gently. Be vary of bugs. Report nicely.
